主要内容: On March 11, 2021, Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. (the "Company") and Robert J. Palle, who served as the Company’s Chief Executive Officer and President during 2019 and was a "named executive officer" for that year, entered into an Omnibus Amendment to Non-Qualified Stock Option Agreements (the "Amendment"). As of December 31, 2020, which was the last day of Mr. Palle’s employment with the Company, he held certain options to purchase shares of the Company’s common stock that, pursuant to their existing terms governing post-termination exercise, would expire on March 31, 2021 if not exercised by that date. Under the terms of the Agreement, the Company has agreed to amend the terms governing post-termination exercise so as to extend the post-termination exercise period with respect to such options until 36 months from the date of his termination. The foregoing summary of the Amendment is not complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Amendment, which is attached as Exhibit 10.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference.
